rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.orders WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.payments WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.refunds WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

rules.description: 환불이 가리키는 상품 행이 없다 (환불이 주문보다 먼저 와도 격리하지 않으므로 경고)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {silver}.refunds r LEFT ANTI JOIN {silver}.order_items i ON r.channel = i.channel AND r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id WHERE r.received_at >= {since}

rules.description: 격리 행이 같은 Bronze 위치의 원본과 다르다 (원본 보존)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {silver}.quarantine q LEFT ANTI JOIN {bronze}.events b ON q.eh_partition = b.eh_partition AND q.eh_offset = b.eh_offset AND q.channel <=> b.channel AND q.payload <=> b.payload WHERE q.ingested_at >= {since}

rules.description: order_items의 (channel, order_item_id) 중복 (시각 컬럼이 없어 전수 확인)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_item_id FROM {silver}.order_items GROUP BY channel, order_item_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_item_id FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item GROUP BY channel, order_item_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, refund_id FROM {gold}.fact_refund GROUP BY channel, refund_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id WHERE f.product_id IS NOT NULL
